blocks.title: Commit Your Works to the Lord

texts.NIV84: To man belong the plans of the heart, but from the LORD comes the reply of the tongue.
texts.KJV: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
The preparations of the heart belong to man,
But the answer of the tongue is from the Lord.
texts.DRB: It is the part of man to prepare the soul: and of the Lord to govern the tongue.

texts.NIV84: All a man's ways seem innocent to him, but motives are weighed by the LORD.
texts.KJV: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.
texts.NKJV:
All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes,
But the Lord weighs the spirits.
texts.DRB: All the ways of a man are open to his eyes: the Lord is the weigher of spirits.

texts.NIV84: Commit to the LORD whatever you do, and your plans will succeed.
texts.KJV: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.
texts.NKJV:
Commit your works to the Lord,
And your thoughts will be established.
texts.DRB: Lay open thy works to the Lord: and thy thoughts shall be directed.

texts.NIV84: The LORD works out everything for his own ends- even the wicked for a day of disaster.
texts.KJV: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord has made all for Himself,
Yes, even the wicked for the day of doom.
texts.DRB: The Lord hath made all things for himself: the wicked also for the evil day.

texts.NIV84: The LORD detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.
texts.KJV: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
texts.NKJV:
Everyone proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord;
Though they join forces, none will go unpunished.
texts.DRB: Every proud man is an abomination to the Lord: though hand should be joined to hand, he is not innocent. The beginning of a good way is to do justice; and this is more acceptable with God, than to offer sacrifices.

texts.NIV84: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the LORD a man avoids evil.
texts.KJV: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.
texts.DRB: By mercy and truth iniquity is redeemed: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

texts.NIV84: When a man's ways are pleasing to the LORD, he makes even his enemies live at peace with him.
texts.KJV: When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
texts.NKJV:
When a man’s ways please the Lord,
He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
texts.DRB: When the ways of man shall please the Lord, he will convert even his enemies to peace.

texts.NIV84: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.
texts.KJV: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
texts.NKJV:
Better is a little with righteousness,
Than vast revenues without justice.
texts.DRB: Better is a little with justice, than great revenues with iniquity.

texts.NIV84: In his heart a man plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
texts.KJV: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.
texts.NKJV:
A man’s heart plans his way,
But the Lord directs his steps.
texts.DRB: The heart of man disposeth his way: but the Lord must direct his steps.

texts.NIV84: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth should not betray justice.
texts.KJV: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
texts.NKJV:
Divination is on the lips of the king;
His mouth must not transgress in judgment.
texts.DRB: Divination is in the lips of the king, his mouth shall not err in judgment.

texts.NIV84: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD; all the weights in the bag are of his making.
texts.KJV: A just weight and balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
texts.NKJV:
Honest weights and scales are the Lord’s;
All the weights in the bag are His work.
texts.DRB: Weight and balance are judgments of the Lord: and his work all the weights of the bag.

texts.NIV84: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
texts.KJV: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
It is an abomination for kings to commit wickedness,
For a throne is established by righteousness.
texts.DRB: They that act wickedly are abominable to the king: for the throne is established by justice.

texts.NIV84: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value a man who speaks the truth.
texts.KJV: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
texts.NKJV:
Righteous lips are the delight of kings,
And they love him who speaks what is right.
texts.DRB: Just lips are the delight of kings: he that speaketh right things shall be loved.

texts.NIV84: A king's wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will appease it.
texts.KJV: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
texts.NKJV:
As messengers of death is the king’s wrath,
But a wise man will appease it.
texts.DRB: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : and the wise man will pacify it.

texts.NIV84: When a king's face brightens, it means life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
texts.KJV: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
texts.NKJV:
In the light of the king’s face is life,
And his favor is like a cloud of the latter rain.
texts.DRB: In the cheerfulness of the king's countenance is life: and his clemency is like the latter rain.

texts.NIV84: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to choose understanding rather than silver!
texts.KJV: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
texts.NKJV:
How much better to get wisdom than gold!
And to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
texts.DRB: Get wisdom, because it is better than gold: and purchase prudence, for it is more precious than silver.

texts.NIV84: The highway of the upright avoids evil; he who guards his way guards his life.
texts.KJV: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
texts.NKJV:
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil;
He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
texts.DRB: The path of the just departeth from evils: he that keepeth his soul keepeth his way.

texts.NIV84: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
texts.KJV: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
texts.NKJV:
Pride goes before destruction,
And a haughty spirit before a fall.
texts.DRB: Pride goeth before destruction: and the spirit is lifted up before a fall.

texts.NIV84: Better to be lowly in spirit and among the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.
texts.KJV: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
texts.NKJV:
Better to be of a humble spirit with the lowly,
Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
texts.DRB: It is better to be humbled with the meek, than to divide spoils with the proud.

texts.NIV84: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
texts.KJV: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.
texts.NKJV:
He who heeds the word wisely will find good,
And whoever trusts in the Lord, happy is he.
texts.DRB: The learned in word shall find good things: and he that trusteth in the Lord is blessed.

texts.NIV84: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant words promote instruction.
texts.KJV: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
texts.NKJV:
The wise in heart will be called prudent,
And sweetness of the lips increases learning.
texts.DRB: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and he that is sweet in words shall attain to greater things.

texts.NIV84: Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, but folly brings punishment to fools.
texts.KJV: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
texts.NKJV:
Understanding is a wellspring of life to him who has it.
But the correction of fools is folly.
texts.DRB: Knowledge is a fountain of life to him that possesseth it: the instruction of fools is foolishness.

texts.NIV84: A wise man's heart guides his mouth, and his lips promote instruction.
texts.KJV: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
texts.NKJV:
The heart of the wise teaches his mouth,
And adds learning to his lips.
texts.DRB: The heart of the wise shall instruct his mouth: and shall add grace to his lips.

texts.NIV84: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
texts.KJV: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
texts.NKJV:
Pleasant words are like a honeycomb,
Sweetness to the soul and health to the bones.
texts.DRB: Well ordered words are as a honeycomb: sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

texts.NIV84: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
texts.KJV: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
texts.NKJV:
There is a way that seems right to a man,
But its end is the way of death.
texts.DRB: There is a way that seemeth to a man right: and the ends thereof lead to death.

texts.NIV84: The laborer's appetite works for him; his hunger drives him on.
texts.KJV: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
texts.NKJV:
The person who labors, labors for himself,
For his hungry mouth drives him on.
texts.DRB: The soul of him that laboureth, laboureth for himself, because his mouth hath obliged him to it.

blocks.title: Every Decision is from the Lord

texts.NIV84: A scoundrel plots evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
texts.KJV: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
texts.NKJV:
An ungodly man digs up evil,
And it is on his lips like a burning fire.
texts.DRB: The wicked man diggeth evil, and in his lips is a burning fire.

texts.NIV84: A perverse man stirs up dissension, and a gossip separates close friends.
texts.KJV: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
texts.NKJV:
A perverse man sows strife,
And a whisperer separates the best of friends.
texts.DRB: A perverse man stirreth up quarrels: and one full of words separateth princes.

texts.NIV84: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.
texts.KJV: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
texts.NKJV:
A violent man entices his neighbor,
And leads him in a way that is not good.
texts.DRB: An unjust man allureth his friend: and leadeth him into a way that is not good

texts.NIV84: He who winks with his eye is plotting perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.
texts.KJV: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
texts.NKJV:
He winks his eye to devise perverse things;
He purses his lips and brings about evil.
texts.DRB: He that with fixed eyes deviseth?? wicked things, biting his lips, bringeth: evil to pass.

texts.NIV84: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained by a righteous life.
texts.KJV: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
The silver-haired head is a crown of glory,
If it is found in the way of righteousness.
texts.DRB: Old age is a crown of dignity, when it is found in the ways of justice.

texts.NIV84: Better a patient man than a warrior, a man who controls his temper than one who takes a city.
texts.KJV: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
texts.NKJV:
He who is slow to anger is better than the mighty,
And he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.
texts.DRB: The patient man is better than the valiant: and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh cities.

texts.NIV84: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
texts.KJV: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
The lot is cast into the lap,
But its every decision is from the Lord.
texts.DRB: Lots are cast into the lap, but they are disposed of by the Lord.
